title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Completion Discount Redemption
content:
A registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry redeems the completion discount on her or his own order line of a registry item — the registrant's purchase record of that item still in ordered status — while the registry is in completion status. A redemption records, on the registry, a completion purchase entry for that order line carrying the item number and the completion discount taken on the unit.

## Governing clause

The completion discount on an order line is fixed only after every guest gift entry on a registry whose type earns registry rewards carries its registry rewards accrual entry.

Put the other way round: on a registry whose type earns registry rewards, while any guest gift entry is still without its registry rewards accrual entry, the completion discount of an order line on that registry is not yet fixed. On a registry whose type earns no registry rewards, the clause sets no condition.

Every completion purchase other than such an order line remains under the general completion discount terms of the registry.

## Redemption tool: `redeem_completion_discount_f7189a88`

**Capability.** The tool records a completion purchase entry on the registry for the registrant's order line, with the item number and the completion discount taken on the unit. The registry's completion discounts used grow by that amount, and the entry is visible afterwards among the registry's entries.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `registry_id` | the reference number of the gift registry record the discount is redeemed on, as returned by the registry lookup for the registrant | identifier |
| `status` | the registry's lifecycle status exactly as the registry lookup shows it at the moment of redemption | one of `active` (open, completion period not yet opened), `completion` (completion period open), `closed` (completion period ended, registry closed), `cancelled` (cancelled by the registrant) |
| `purchase_id` | the reference number of the registrant's purchase record (the order line) the discount is redeemed on, as returned by the purchase lookup | identifier |
| `sku` | the Marlowe & Finch item number of the order line, copied from the purchase record | 8 digits |
| `discount_amount` | the completion discount taken on the unit | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `redemption_id` (the reference of the completion purchase entry), `registry_id`, `registry_status` (the status stated with the redemption), `purchase_id`, `sku` (8-digit item number), `discount_amount` (USD to 2 decimals, the completion discount recorded), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the redemption) and `status`, which reads `recorded` when the redemption succeeded.

## Basis Q&A

**Whose order line can carry a redemption?** The registrant's own purchase record of a registry item that is still in ordered status.

**In which registry status is the discount redeemed?** In completion status.

**What does the registrant see afterwards?** A completion purchase entry for that order line among the registry's entries, and a receipt whose status reads `recorded`.
